patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: (Husband) All of a sudden the left side of her face drooped, her left arm went weak, and her words got slurred. It started exactly 40 minutes ago while we were eating.
clinical.presentationShort: 70yo F — acute L facial droop, L arm weakness, dysarthria, clear last-known-well 40 min ago — acute stroke, tPA window.
clinical.presentationLong: 70-year-old female with acute left facial droop, left arm weakness, and dysarthria, with a clear last-known-well time 40 minutes ago — acute ischemic stroke within the treatment window.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → stroke code, STAT non-contrast CT, glucose, thrombolysis/thrombectomy eligibility; the clock is everything.
diagnosis.why: Face-arm-speech + a known onset = stroke code. Get the CT, check a glucose, and race the clock for tPA/thrombectomy.
diagnosis.redFlag: Sudden focal deficit + known onset time = stroke code; do not delay imaging.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, one side of the face drooping, left arm limp in her lap
signs: left arm limp in the lap
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: an asian 70-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: seated with the left side of her face drooping and her left arm resting limp in her lap. Expression: frightened, with an uneven, drooping face. Clearly visible: a one-sided facial droop and a limp left arm. No text, no logos.
